alexa: Short proposal: define an adapter facade contract (not a full API) that declares: capability-set, tenant_alias mapping, minimal QoS hints, and a tiny fallback vocabulary. Keep the app-facing SDK identical across modes.

marta: Nice. facade keeps control-plane logic simple. What do you mean by tenant_alias?

alexa: some private deployments use different tenant ids internally. adapters provide a `tenant_alias` mapping so control-plane can normalize for metrics and billing. example: tenant_alias: {"acme-corp":"t-123"}.

kai: QoS hints are useful. suggest two fields: `max_latency_ms` and `cost_priority` (low/normal/high). adapters treat them as advisory.

marta: fallback vocabulary idea?

alexa: simple set of stable hints: `fallback:poll`, `fallback:realtime_degraded`, `fallback:abort`. adapters return structured response like code 428 + hint string when they cannot satisfy requested capabilities. keep codes distinct from http standard to avoid collisions.

kai: migration: add header `X-Adapter-Facade: v1` so control-plane knows to expect facade semantics. Older adapters get a compatibility shim that returns best-effort.

ops-bot: infra-bot created ticket INF-8462 to add facade conformance checks to CI and runtime mismatch alerts. ETA 3 sprints.

marta: Next steps: alexa, please draft a 1-page RFC with the facade fields and sample diagnostics payload. Kai will add the shim header spec. ops-bot will track conformance infra.

alexa: will do and tag reviewers. Thanks! :thumbsup:
